_: Typed seam ledger in the seam-gate schema, one row per seam. A cut row carries signed exit/entry vectors that must agree: the exit still moving on the cut frame, the entry already in flight. The two morph rows name the intended carrier handoff, but their rects do not agree yet (cards and terminal are ~356 px apart at 5.6 s; wrap and stage ~98 px apart at 8.6 s), so seam-gate's carrier check fails on both. They stay as 2.4.0 shipped them until the next re-render starts #term and #stage from the outgoing rects. No seam here is a static boundary, a continuity choice made for this demo: two seams are carrier handoffs and two are swaps cut mid-motion on the same axis and sign. Every exit still has a tl.set hard kill with the same selector string on the cut frame. Keep the rows matched when you retime anything.
